MADSCIENTIST-TOME_OF_SCIENCE.title: Tome of Science
MADSCIENTIST-TOME_OF_SCIENCE.description: At the start of your turn, Repair 1. At the end of your turn, gain Block equal to your Machine Durability.
MADSCIENTIST-TOME_OF_SCIENCE.flavor: A lab journal full of marginalia.
MADSCIENTIST-TOME_OF_AWAKENING.title: Tome of Awakening
MADSCIENTIST-TOME_OF_AWAKENING.descripti: At the start of your turn, Repair 3. At the end of your turn, gain Block equal to your Machine Durability and deal that much damage to ALL enemies.
MADSCIENTIST-TOME_OF_AWAKENING.flavor: The pages turn themselves; the ink runs hot.
